title: Evaluating Polyphenol Derivatives on Cancer Stem Cells Using Two- and Three-dimensional Tumoroid Models: Insights From In Vitro and In Silico Studies.
authors: Bilgin, Sema; Tayhan, Secil Erden; Yasar, Seyma; Kocaman, Asli Yildirim; Koc, Esra
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接评估多酚衍生物与干细胞转录因子Sox2/Oct4/Nanog的结合，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白但无DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题核心TF-DNA互作机制研究关联较弱。
abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) drive tumor initiation, metastasis, drug resistance, and recurrence, making them critical therapeutic targets. This study investigated two isoeugenol-derived polyphenolic compounds, designated as 1 and 2, in breast, prostate, and colon CSCs using monolayer and three-dimensional tumoroid models. After 48 h, both compounds significantly inhibited proliferation. In prostate cancer cells, compound 2 exhibited a lower half-maximal inhibitory concentration (17.18 microM) than compound 1 (21.04 microM) and 5-fluorouracil (5-Fu) (21.51 microM). In three-dimensional tumoroids, compound 2 reduced tumoroid diameters by an additional 8% compared to 5-Fu. Molecular docking with AutoDock 4.2 revealed strong interactions between both compounds and key stemness regulators Sox2, Oct4, and Nanog. Compound 2 displayed the most favorable binding energies (-6.31 kcal/mol for Oct4, -5.36 for Nanog, and -4.62 for Sox2), suggesting stable complex formation that may disrupt core transcription factors. These findings support further investigation of polyphenol derivatives as potential CSC-targeting agents, with additional in vivo and pharmacokinetic studies needed to confirm therapeutic viability.
abstract_zh: 癌症干细胞（CSCs）驱动肿瘤发生、转移、耐药和复发，使其成为关键的治疗靶点。本研究在乳腺、前列腺和结肠CSCs中，使用单层和三维肿瘤样模型，考察了两种异丁香酚衍生的多酚类化合物（命名为1和2）。48小时后，两种化合物均显著抑制增殖。在前列腺癌细胞中，化合物2表现出较低的半数抑制浓度（17.18微摩尔），低于化合物1（21.04微摩尔）和5-氟尿嘧啶（5-Fu）（21.51微摩尔）。在三维肿瘤样中，与5-Fu相比，化合物2使肿瘤样直径额外减少了8%。使用AutoDock 4.2进行的分子对接显示，两种化合物与关键干性调控因子Sox2、Oct4和Nanog之间存在强相互作用。化合物2显示出最有利的结合能（Oct4为-6.31 kcal/mol，Nanog为-5.36，Sox2为-4.62），表明可能形成稳定复合物，从而干扰核心转录因子。这些发现支持进一步研究多酚衍生物作为潜在的CSC靶向药物，但需进行额外的体内和药代动力学研究以确认其治疗可行性。
